project_identity.name: GastoControl - Gestor de Gastos
project_identity.target_audience: Individuals, couples, and small teams tracking personal or project expenses who need instant AI receipt extraction, budget control, and clear category breakdowns.
project_identity.emotional_tone: Grounded, tactical, trustworthy, warm craftsmanship meets financial precision.

theme.archetype: Organic & Earthy Masonry (Warm Stone + Terracotta Clay + Deep Slate)

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#1A1D20]
scale.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-[#717882]

responsive.layout: Single column stack on mobile (<768px) with bottom or top quick action floating bar; 12-column bento grid on desktop (>=1024px).
responsive.typography: Fluid rem-based scaling. Inputs minimum 16px to prevent mobile browser auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden on root containers to prevent horizontal scrolling.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px interactive tap targets for all mobile controls and buttons.

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-8
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for cards and containers, rounded-xl for inputs and buttons

header_navigation.style: Sticky top bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF8F5]/90 border-b border-[#E2DDD3] z-40
elements: Brand Logo: GastoControl with wallet & receipt icon
Sync Pill: 'Sincronizado en tiempo real' with pulsing green badge
Quick CTA: '+ Añadir Gasto' & 'Escanear Ticket AI'
Navigation Tabs: Dashboard, Gastos, Tickets AI, Presupuesto, Galería

kpi_summary_grid.style: 4-column grid (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 4 col desktop)

ai_receipt_scanner.style: Drag and drop zone with camera capture trigger on mobile. Visual scanning laser animation during AI analysis.
ai_receipt_scanner.manual_override: Full inline edit capability before saving to database

receipt_gallery_and_export.gallery: Grid of ticket thumbnails with quick preview modal, full image zoom, and download link.
receipt_gallery_and_export.export_csv: Instant CSV export button with category breakdown, date, supplier, amount, and notes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire application is in Spanish ('Gasto', 'Ticket', 'Presupuesto', 'General', 'Compras', 'Facturas', 'Exportar CSV').
Implement real working client-side or backend AI OCR receipt data extraction simulation with instant visual feedback, high confidence scores, and line-item breakdown.
Add test attributes `data-testid` to all interactive buttons, inputs, modals, filters, and cards.
Use Lucide icons for categories and actions.
Use Sonner (`toast`) for feedback when adding expenses, uploading receipts, or exporting CSV.
Make the UI mobile-first responsive so it looks and works seamlessly on smartphones as well as desktop computers.
